appraisal_events.evidence: parlait comme Tirésias et eût écrit comme Tacite... elle excellait à régler ces mises en scène... l'art à la fois génial et patient d'Irving et de Frédéric Lemaître... Françoise avait l'air de la « Justice éclairant le Crime »; and her final reply is delivered 'avec une ambiguïté cruelle'.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator repeatedly elevates Françoise, comparing her indirect, wordless mastery of exposing the couple's secret to great writers and actors, and casting her, in the lamp-lit tableau and her final cryptic reply, as an almost allegorical figure of Justice with full command of the scene.

status_effects.explanation: Françoise is clearly elevated by an extended chain of literary and theatrical comparisons (Tiresias, Tacitus, Irving, Frédéric Lemaître, 'Justice éclairant le Crime') that credit her with genius-level indirect mastery over the household's secrets.
